newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Roche says likely to appeal Akzo ruling.
newsitem.headline: Roche says likely to appeal Akzo ruling.

text.p: Pharmaceutical group Roche Holding AG said it would probably lodge an appeal against a German court ruling that Dutch company Akzo Nobel NV was not infringing Roche patents.
Chemical group Akzo earlier announced that a Duesseldorf court ruled in favour of its unit Organon Teknika in a patent dispute brought by Roche unit Hoffmann-La Roche.
The Roche spokesman's said he had not heard of the ruling but believed that it would be appealed.
"We will certainly not let this stand this way," the spokesman told Reuters.
Akzo said the Duesseldorf district court ruled on October 1 that Organon Teknika tests for Aids virus HIV did not infringe on a nucleic acid amplification patent owned by Roche.
This ruling confirms earlier judgements in the Netherlands by the District Court and the Appeal Court, in The Hague.
The Roche spokesman said the Duesseldorf decision, if upheld, would have no impact on Roche results because Akzo's market share was too small.
